description: A six-step sequence read out as a repeating voltage, either as steps or smoothed into a shape.

params.text: How much the FQ jack moves that rate. With nothing patched into FQ this knob is a fine tune instead.
The rate the sequence steps at.
The voltage of the first step.
The voltage of the second step.
The voltage of the third step.
The voltage of the fourth step.
The voltage of the fifth step.
The voltage of the sixth step.
Sets how the steps are joined: up leaves them stepped, middle draws a straight line between them, down draws a curve.

inputs.text: A clock for the sequence: a rising edge restarts it, and the FQ knob is then read as a division of that clock.
Moves the step rate, by as much as the MOD knob allows.

outputs.text: The six step voltages read out in turn.
A ramp following the position through the sequence, which doubles as a clock output.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.

inputs.0:
high above 2.5V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
±6.24V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the MOD knob acts as a fine tune.
